label: VERIFIED
extraction: Claude Cookbook async multi-agent orchestration patterns. Two patterns behind Claude Opus 4.8 system card results: 1) Fixed N-agent team with peer messaging through shared hub, 2) Dynamically spawned async subagents. Reduced to bare messaging and lifecycle mechanics. Uses Anthropic Python SDK + asyncio. Shared building blocks: event dict with asyncio.Event per agent, status dict, ID counter, register/new_name/post methods for messaging. No domain task - just mechanics so users can drop in their own tools/task. Shows exactly which tools fire and in what order. Runs typically under 30 seconds with any API key. Pattern enables understanding of tool firing order before adding domain logic.
transfer_harness_fact: no paid keys (no GPT-4, no cloud GPU)
